EVERYONE IS WELCOME IN BROOKHAVEN
Brookhaven is a town built by everyone in it. A place where everyone belongs. A place for community, discovery, and curiosity.
Create Your World.
Houses, shops, a school, a hospital, the works. Run a cafe today, a fire station tomorrow. Pick where you live. Drive any car you want. It's all yours.
Play with New and Old Friends.
There are millions of players a day in Brookhaven. Some are throwing birthday parties. Some are hanging out at the fountain. Your friends are probably already here.
Explore and Discover.
Brookhaven has a secret. People have been finding pieces of it for years. Strange doors. Glowing rooms. Stuff that wasn't there yesterday. Solve Brookhaven mysteries.
WELCOME TO BROOKHAVEN!
Create, discover, role play and explore in Brookhaven- it's your world!

Tux & Shepherd on the Stray Case Notes!
Post by
byKotney
Published:
Fri, Aug 14, 2026
Happy update day! This week, a Mysterious Stranger asks for help, while Inspector Shepherd recruits Tux Kitt for the Stray Case 🕵️‍♂️
Mysterious Stranger’s Task!
Investigation of the whereabouts of this stranger, and their plans on Adoption Island, has been well underway for weeks. Inspector Shepherd sniffs along a trail of forks leading to the School, while cooperating with Tux Kitt.
Knock on the door to speak with the grumpy stranger and receive a Task.
Bring the Mysterious Stranger 6 Bundles of Forks in exchange for 75 Bucks.
Take your pet on a walk and wait for them to identify Bundles of Forks, hiding in plain sight.
This can be done once every in-game day!
Tux Kitt and the Witness!
Two new pets are on the Stray Case! Shepherd has called in reinforcements in the form of Kitt. Tux Kitt. Cat spy, agent provo
cat
eur, to work his charms on the Strays and get to the bottom of this cat-filled-cafeteria.
Vit Ness, the yappy, hyperattentive Chihuahua, is aware of ALL of the changes on Adoption Island. No forks will be polymorphed without Vit Ness noticing it and making a prompt report.
🐶 Chihuahua - Hatch from the Basic & Crystal Egg -
Ultra Rare
👀 Sneaky Newspaper - 250 Bucks -
Common
🤵 Tuxedo Cat - 200 Robux -
Ultra Rare
👓 AR Glasses - 1,300 Bucks -
Rare
👔 Secret Agent Tie - 800 Bucks -
Uncommon
🤠 Spy Fedora - 750 Bucks -
Uncommon
We have got to get inside that room...
Bug fixes and improvements!
🐛 Canceling or declining an offer in the Trading Hub works a lot quicker now
🐞 Tooltips now display correctly when using the Trading Hub on a tablet
🐛Fixed House Edit Tooltips not showing
🐞Music during Admin Abuse and 2D Tuesdays no longer changes when speaking to NPCs
🐛Trade restricted countries now display the specific popup text when attempting to post in the Trading Hub

Titanic Mariachi Capybara
can drop!
🚀 Fiesta Race
The race is
BACK
for round two!
Race to level
400,000
to claim the
GARGANTUAN
!
The
#1
top place gets the
RAINBOW SHINY
!
Below Level
150,000
? You grind with
10x XP
to catch up!
On your marks...
Limited Pets
💪 Gargantuan Returns
Missed the
GARGANTUAN Sombrero Cat
? It's back!
Win the
race
, or crack the Prize Room's
Titanic egg
!
Boost your odds with
Gargantuan Luck
at the Boosts Machine!
The
rarest prize
of the whole fiesta!
🔥 Limited Titanic Pets
Check out these sweet
TITANIC
pets!
Titanic Mariachi Capybara
- Fiesta Maze Prize Room
Titanic Catrina Cat
- Push your luck in the maze
Titanic Desert Scorpion
- Top the Fiesta Leaderboard and League
⭐ Limited Huge Pets
A wave of new
HUGE
pets have arrived!
Huge Desert Coyote
- Fiesta Maze (Easy)
Huge Mariachi Coati
- Fiesta Maze (Hard)
Huge Marigold Manatee
- Push your luck in the maze
Huge Marigold Donkey
- Top the Fiesta Leaderboard and League
🐾 New Fiesta Pets
Collect
8
brand-new Fiesta pets!
Meet the
Mariachi Capybara
,
Desert Scorpion
, and
more
!
They all out-hit last week's pets, and the
Catrina Cat
hits hardest!
The Piñata Challenge doubled to
200 levels
, climb to hatch them all!
Event
🍀 Boosts Machine
Feed the
Boosts Machine
your Fiesta Coins!
The
more
you feed it, the
longer
your boosts last.
Fiesta Damage
- +500% maze damage
Fiesta Key Luck
- +200% Fiesta Key drops
Fiesta Huge Luck
- +400% Huge Egg odds
Fiesta Titanic Luck
- +2,000% Titanic Egg odds
Fiesta Gargantuan Luck
- +400% Gargantuan odds
Stack up to
6 hours
per boost, then go hunt.
Damage boosts work in the Eternal Maze too!
⚡ Tier III Boosts
The maze boosters go up a
tier
!
Damage Booster III
- +400% maze damage
XP Booster III
- +800% maze XP
Instant XP Booster III
- A HUGE burst of instant maze XP
Find them in the
Marigold Pack
and the
Forever Pack
!
The
Damage
and
XP
boosters can even drop from
Fiesta Gifts
!
🗝️ Fiesta Boss Key
Hunt down the
Fiesta Boss Key
!
Bosses
1
and
2
drop halves to
combine
, Boss
3
drops it whole.
Spend one to open the
SECRET room
hiding by the final boss!
Inside waits a boss
5x tougher
with
boosted
chase pet odds!
📈 New Level Cap
The grind goes
DEEPER
!
The level cap rockets from
150,000
to
400,000
!
Every level pays
Fiesta Orbs
, all the way up.
⬆️ New Upgrades
The Upgrade Machine grew from
4
tracks to
12
!
New tracks include
Better Loot
,
More XP
,
More Fiesta Coins
, and
Speedy Pets
.
Plus
Boss Damage
,
Better Titanic Egg Luck
, and
Boss Huge & Titanic Chances
!
Grind to the new cap and your orbs can
max nearly every track
!
Contests
🥇 Fiesta League
The
League
crowns the squad with the most
Battle Points
!
Create a
squad of 4
, every
reward egg
anyone opens counts!
Harder mazes pay
way more
points, so climb the ranks!
#1 Place:
Rainbow Shiny Titanic Desert Scorpion
#2-3 Place:
Golden Shiny Titanic Desert Scorpion
#4-15 Place:
Rainbow Titanic Desert Scorpion
#16-50 Place:
Shiny Titanic Desert Scorpion
#51-100 Place:
Golden Titanic Desert Scorpion
#101-250 Place:
Titanic Desert Scorpion
#251-1,000 Place:
Rainbow Huge Marigold Donkey
#1,001-2,500 Place:
Golden Huge Marigold Donkey
#2,501-5,000 Place:
Huge Marigold Donkey
Every member
in your squad gets the prize!
Good luck!
🏆 Fiesta Leaderboard
Go
deepest
in the
Eternal Maze
to climb the Leaderboard!
The top players win the
Titanic Desert Scorpion
!
Rank high for the
Huge Marigold Donkey
!
Exclusive
🍬 Marigold Pack
Stock up with the brand-new
Marigold Pack
!
Packed with
20 Tier III Boosters
,
3 Fiesta Boss Keys
, and
5 Exclusive Eggs
!
Plus
12 Fiesta Keys
,
100 Candy
, and two
Mega Chests
!
Limited-time only!
🌈 The Forever Pack
The party never stops with the
Forever Pack
!
Featuring the brand-new
Huge Catrin Dog
!
And, of course, the
Titanic Sombrero Corgi
and
Gargantuan Capybara
!
Stocked with
Keys
,
Boosts
, and
Gift Bags
!
Limited-time only - party while you can!
Changes
🔀 New Pet Sorts
Two new sorts join your
pet inventory
!
Power
- Strongest regular pets first, Huges and exclusives at the end
Hatched
- Your Huge, Titanic, and Gargantuan hatches first, newest on top
Regular pets stack, so only the big ones have hatch dates!
Straight from
player feedback
.
🖥️ Trading Terminal
Find what you're hunting in
way fewer clicks
!
New tabs for
Gifts
,
Huge
,
Titanic
,
Gargantuan
, and
Old
discontinued items.
Sorting
- Every tab sorts by Name, Exists, RAP, or Rarity
Index filter
- Show only pets you're missing, then teleport to a booth selling one
Recents
- Your recent searches now sit first
It opens
instantly
now, too.
🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed
Auto Raid
players getting kicked after 20 minutes.
Fixed
buff timers
visually skipping ahead 30 seconds.
Fixed
mazes
spawning break zones outside the areas.
Fixed
leaderboards
to page past the top 100, so you can find yourself.
¡VIVA LA FIESTA!
~ Preston & PS99 Dev Team
